description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Historic rail locations and company/status attributes describe earlier railway infrastructure. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including COMPANY, STATUS. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. The source archive spans the 1850s through 2010; this is distinct from the active non-abandoned railway layer. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. Related existing records below provide broader network or asset-location context; their scope is distinct from this resource.
